definition: Incurable Insanity is a legal grounds for obtaining a divorce under family law. In Scott v. Scott, the Court of Appeals of North Carolina defined the term “Incurable Insanity” as being “so mentally impaired that he/she does not understand what he/she is engaged in doing and the nature and consequences of his/her acts”. However, it is rarely used because of the difficulty of proving both the insanity of the spouse being divorced and that the insanity is incurable. incorporeal ownership / incurable insanity Dictionary compilation | 26 September 2026
